evals.name: typical
evals.prompt: 用太宰治的文风写一篇关于同学聚会失败经历的告白体短篇。
evals.expected_output: 先给自然的日语原创成稿，再给忠实中文翻译；呈现自我形象与泄露本心的错位、笑意与悲哀，避免复用原作句子。
expectations: First line is exactly '## 日语原文' with no preface
Shows a gap between self-image and what the narrator lets slip, with laughter close to sorrow
Gives a faithful Chinese translation, not a summary

forbidden_regex: \A\s*(好的|当然|没问题|以下是|下面是|Sure|Certainly|Here is|Here's)
